summary: one-call session bootstrap: journal tail, tasks, inbox, proposals, index age, last commit, backup status, git, recent notes
hints: Read-only session bootstrap for humans and agents in one call. --json = the full envelope; --line = a ≤60-char string cached (short TTL, PLAINKEEP_ORIENT_TTL) for a starship/tmux prompt hook. `backup_age_min` is a deprecated alias of `last_commit_age_min`; `backup_last_ok` is null until a verified `backup run`. Common mistake: confusing it with `plainkeep start`, which writes the journal.
